newsitem.title: GREECE: SOCCER-YUGOSLAV STRIKER TO MISS REST OF GREEK SEASON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-YUGOSLAV STRIKER TO MISS REST OF GREEK SEASON.

text.p: Yugoslav international striker Ilia Ivic will miss the rest of the Greek season after undergoing knee surgery, an Olympiakos official said on Tuesday.
"Ilia underwent successful surgery and he'll be out for at least three months. In essence, he'll miss the entire season," the club spokesman said.
Ivic, who injured the knee in leaders Olympiakos' victory over Kavala on Sunday, will also miss Yugoslavia's match against the Czech Republic in their next World Cup qualifier on April 2.
